classification.difficultyReason: Complete multiplication pyramids using products and reverse calculations involving algebraic terms.

content.prompt: In each part, the expression in each box is obtained by multiplying together the terms in the two boxes directly below it. Fill in the empty boxes.

spec.description: Three bottom boxes, two centred middle boxes and one centred top box. All upper boxes are response regions.
spec.mathematics: Each upper box is the product of the adjacent pair immediately below.

spec.description: Bottom centre, middle right and top boxes are empty.
spec.mathematics: Bottom outer givens 4m and 2p; middle left given 16mn.

spec.description: Bottom left, bottom centre and middle right boxes are empty.
spec.mathematics: Bottom right 2b; middle left 24a; top 48a squared b.

answer.short: Bottom left: $24$. Bottom centre: $a$. Middle right: $2ab$.

spec.mathematics: 24 times a equals 24a; a times 2b equals 2ab; their product is 48a squared b.

spec.description: Bottom outer boxes and middle right box are empty.
spec.mathematics: Bottom centre 2m; middle left 16mn squared; top 96m squared n squared q.

answer.short: Bottom left: $8n^2$. Bottom right: $3q$. Middle right: $6mq$.

spec.mathematics: 8n squared times 2m equals 16mn squared; 2m times 3q equals 6mq; their product is 96m squared n squared q.
